All 9 tests pass now. There were two bugs, one in each source file.

1. **`src/bill.js`, off-by-one in `splitBill`:** the check `i <= leftover` gave one extra person a leftover cent. I changed it to `i < leftover`, so exactly `leftover` people get one. This fixed the even-split, leftover-cents and total-preserved tests.

2. **`src/duration.js`, no check on the whole string in `parseDuration`:** it only looked for `(\d+)(h|m|s)` matches anywhere in the text. Input like `"10m and change"` was accepted and the junk was ignored. It now throws a `SyntaxError` unless the whole string matches `^(\d+[hms])+$`. This fixed the trailing-junk test. The old "no matches" check is covered by the new one, so I replaced it rather than keeping both.

I didn't touch the tests or commit anything.
